detail.longDescription: Cannot get through my docker container and connect to my local ollama server. Ollama server is up and running : http://localhost:11434 returns "Ollama is running" When adding n8n credentials for ollama, I get the following : Couldn't connect with these settings ECONNREFUSED Here's my n8n credentials config : Base URL : http://host.docker.internal:11434 API Key : not needed for local install and running models (?!) Allowed HTTP Request Domains : All According to what I've found, looks like we need to provide manually the host.docker.internal:host-gateway flags for linux hosts. This can be done either in compose.yaml or by command line : # compose.yaml n8n extra-hosts : - host.docker.internal:host-gateway # command line docker run --add-host="host.docker.internal:host-gateway" <image-name> This should resolve DNS requests from internal docker container to the local host. Detail Config : Docker version 29.10.0 Docker Compose version 5.8.0 n8n version 2.48.7
